# Ontology Pipeline

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

A framework for knowledge management engineering.

## Scope note

- Described by Jessica Talisman in her book "Ontology Pipeline: A Framework for Knowledge Management Engineering".
- Includes controlled vocabulary, metadata standards, taxonomy, thesaurus, ontology, and knowledge graphs.
